body.purpose: All reading text, descriptions, log entries. Core reading size.

title.purpose: Page headings, modal titles, bike names. Never display-sized.

label.purpose: Section headers, field labels, status badges. Tabular numerics.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Cards and modals against the void-black canvas.

motion.name: jelly-ease
motion.purpose: Spring easing for interactive state changes — snappy, physical, never bouncy.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Phosphor Violet, spring press feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: #a78bfa; color: #09091a; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 16px; border: none; font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), background 0.15s; user-select: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c4b5fd; transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.94) translateY(2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a78bfa; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent, no border, subtle hover fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.52); padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 16px; border: none; font: 500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action. Always paired with a ConfirmDialog — never fires on first click.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #ff7070; color: #fff; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 16px; border: none; font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s, transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.94) translateY(2px); }

components.name: Glass Input
components.description: Text field on glass surface. Filled style, violet focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius: 16px; font: 400 14px/1.55 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.32); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(167,139,250,0.35); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(167,139,250,0.15); }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Standard glass panel. Used for bike cards, log entries, settings sections.

narrative.overview:
My Bike's interface is built on a single metaphor: a precision instrument panel — dark, purposeful, and unmistakably personal. Every surface is a glass layer over a deep void, every accent is a phosphor glow. The design doesn't decorate; it informs.

The Jelly Glass system is the identity, not a theme. Dark mode is not toggled — it is the product. Surfaces are translucent glass panels stacked over #09091a void-black. Accent colors behave like instrument lights: rare, meaningful, never decorative.

This system explicitly rejects: generic SaaS grays, bloated OEM car-app chrome, over-animated interface theater, and plain-white utility design.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first: #09091a void-black canvas, glass surfaces at 6-11% white opacity
Spring physics: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) — snappy, never bouncy
Phosphor accents: violet primary, green success, red warning — all used sparingly
One sans: Inter throughout — no display font, no decorative mixing

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Phosphor Violet appears on ≤10% of any given screen. It marks what matters. If violet is everywhere, it marks nothing.

rules.name: The Glass Stack Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are never opaque. Every card, modal, and panel is a glass layer — rgba(255,255,255,0.06–0.11) — over void-black.

rules.name: The No Pure White Rule
rules.body: White text is always rgba(255,255,255,0.92), never #ffffff. Pure white on dark glass causes halation.

rules.name: The No Display Font Rule
rules.body: Inter in its weight range is the entire typographic vocabulary. If a heading needs to feel bolder, increase weight to 700.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Rule
rules.body: No crisp, offset shadows. Every shadow should be diffuse enough to appear as a glow from underneath, not a border.

dos: Do use rgba(255,255,255,0.06–0.11) glass surfaces — never solid fills for cards or panels.
Do keep Phosphor Violet to ≤10% of any screen.
Do use spring easing cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) for interactive state changes.
Do size all touch targets at ≥44px height.
Do use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for mileage, date, and numeric columns.
Do pair destructive buttons with a ConfirmDialog — always two interactions.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS dashboard patterns — no Notion-style sidebar, no Linear-style activity feed.
Don't use bloated OEM car-app chrome.
Don't add over-animated transitions — no bounce easing, no choreographed page-load sequences.
Don't use plain white utility styling — no white backgrounds, no light-gray card surfaces.
Don't use display or decorative fonts.
Don't use full-opacity white text — always rgba(255,255,255,0.92) or lower.
Don't use Modal as a first thought — accordion expansion is preferred.
